published.source: Tauren, Nature's Focus pushback and the client 70425 racials (2026-10-16)

summary: The cat keeping Faerie Fire (Feral) on the target for the raid. Its own Shreds and white hits get the armor too, so the duty costs only the 1 s GCDs and the first second or so before it lands.
rotation: Opener: plain Cat Form (no Stealth/Prowl or Ravage)
Racials, trinkets and potions on cooldown; Berserk with the on-use trinket
Faerie Fire (Feral) from Cat Form first after the cooldowns, again once it has under 7 s left, so a miss gets a retry (free, 1 s GCD, 6 s cooldown)
Shifting Power at 50 Energy or less, unless a Ferocious Bite is due (5 CP and Rip has 6 s or more)
Ferocious Bite at any combo points in the last 2 s
Rip at 4+ combo points when it is down (not in the last 8 s)
Ferocious Bite at 5 combo points and 35 Energy while Rip has 6 s or more left (or in the last 8 s)
caveats: Costs 6.0 / 5.1 / 4.4 DPS against the base build at 120 / 180 / 300 s
Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 29 Agility and 17 Strength, and 165 Strength for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Rip's level 31+ client ranks are 6-9% below Era: Era values would give +1.6%
Howling Idol (0.5 s off Shifting Power since client 1.60.1.70425) is worth 4.8 at 180 s; 5-piece Grovekeeper Ferocity would add 5.9 (measured before the 5a and 1b rounds)
Unverified: Shred's flat bonus, AP on Rip and Ferocious Bite, Rend and Tear's scope
Keeping Rake up costs 33; Rip at 5 CP ties
Only one +2% crit elixir by standard; Grizzly in place of Ferocity would add 4.9
Tiger's Fury is removed in Forever (replaced by Shifting Power); it was worth 24.9 at 180 s
The cat's swing spreads 20% either side of the weapon's DPS (the server's range isn't visible)
Windfury Totem in the melee group is +13.3 over Grace of Air; Dense Weightstone on the mace is +4.9 (Elemental Sharpening Stone left out: its plans only drop in Molten Core)
notes: druid__feral-cat.json with the raid's Faerie Fire and Curse of Recklessness off (Forever's two share the minor armor slot, standards 20, so with the curse on the druid's own Faerie Fire adds nothing) and the level60_ff rotation. Everything else is the base request.
